name: ZENCAPTCHA
description: CAPTCHA plugin integrating the Zencaptcha service with the CAPTCHA module.
project_description:
Protect your users privacy while preventing spam and abuse.

 ZENCAPTCHA protects forms from abuse by bots and unfair users. Reduces spam, blocks fake and disposable email addresses and increases your user base quality without the use of cookies. Fully GDPR compliant and made in the EU.

 Features 
 - Blocks bots without decreasing user experience of real users.

- Detects invalid and temporary email addresses and asks users to provide their real email address

- Together, they are a powerful force for spam reduction.

 Requirements 
 - ZENCAPTCHA depends on the  CAPTCHA  module.

- To use ZENCAPTCHA , you need to generate a site key and secret key on the ZENCAPTCHA.com website.
